nodes.label: Soft Delete Policy and Exceptions
nodes.rationale: Soft-delete (deleted_at column) on 20 model files. Intentional exceptions: AuditLog (immutable), ComplianceStandard/ChecklistItem (reference data), ProjectComplianceItem (certification evidence), ExportJob (ownership record), Notification (current UX is mark-read), ReferenceCounter (system sequencing), RefreshToken (uses revoked_at instead), TaskDependency (relationship table). Document deactivates via is_active instead.
